name: Frigorific-Reach

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by petrified remnants of a former biosphere and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Regular pulses leave the ancient alien ruins aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
